title: Fibonacci · recursive
description: Ten evaluations of F(30), using the standard two-branch recursive algorithm. General integer arithmetic; no type annotations, memoization or implementation-specific shortcuts.

title: Ironclad · modular exponentiation
description: 100,000 modular exponentiations: bases 2 through 100,001, exponent 65,537, modulus 104,729. Original Ironclad POWER-MOD and POWER-MOD-TAB source, including upstream optimization declarations. This is a small-integer kernel, not RSA-sized arithmetic.

title: Conditions · caught type errors
description: 2,000 calls with a real TYPE-ERROR every 97th iteration, caught by HANDLER-CASE. The checksum includes all normal values while caught errors contribute zero.
